litigation.name: Litigation & Disputes
litigation.description: Representation before trial courts, tribunals and the High Court in civil, criminal, family, consumer and property matters.

business-registration.name: Business Registration
business-registration.description: Company, LLP and firm incorporation with end-to-end documentation, filings and post-registration compliance.

tax.name: Tax Services
tax.description: GST and income-tax registration, return filing and representation in departmental notices and proceedings.

intellectual-property.name: Intellectual Property
intellectual-property.description: Trademark, copyright and patent protection — search, filing, prosecution and enforcement.

civil-litigation.name: Civil Litigation
civil-litigation.summary: Suits, injunctions, recovery and appeals argued with thorough preparation.
civil-litigation.description: We represent plaintiffs and defendants in civil suits — money recovery, declarations, injunctions, specific performance and appeals. Every matter begins with an honest assessment of its strength, followed by clear strategy, careful drafting and vigorous argument.
bullets: Case assessment with a realistic opinion on merits and timelines
Drafting of plaints, written statements, applications and appeals
Interim relief: injunctions, attachment and stay applications
Representation before trial courts and the High Court
Execution proceedings to actually realise your decree

criminal-litigation.name: Criminal Litigation
criminal-litigation.summary: Bail, trial defence and complaints handled with urgency and discretion.
criminal-litigation.description: From the first police notice to the final judgment, we defend clients at every stage of a criminal proceeding — bail and anticipatory bail, quashing petitions, trial defence and appeals — and assist complainants in filing and pursuing cases.
bullets: Bail and anticipatory bail applications, argued on priority
Advice on police notices, FIRs and arrest procedure
Trial defence with meticulous cross-examination
Quashing petitions and criminal appeals before the High Court
Complaint drafting and prosecution support for victims

divorce-matrimonial-cases.name: Divorce & Matrimonial Cases
divorce-matrimonial-cases.summary: Divorce, maintenance and custody handled with sensitivity and firmness.
divorce-matrimonial-cases.description: Family disputes need both empathy and precision. We advise on mutual-consent and contested divorce, maintenance, domestic violence proceedings and child custody — always seeking the resolution that protects your future and your children.
bullets: Mutual-consent divorce completed with minimum friction
Contested divorce petitions and defence
Maintenance and alimony claims under all applicable laws
Child custody and visitation arrangements
Protection orders in domestic violence proceedings

cheque-bounce-cases.name: Cheque Bounce Cases
cheque-bounce-cases.summary: Section 138 complaints and defence, from notice to judgment.
cheque-bounce-cases.description: Dishonoured cheques are governed by strict timelines. We issue and reply to statutory demand notices, file and defend complaints under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, and pursue parallel recovery where it strengthens your position.
bullets: Statutory demand notice within the limitation period
Filing and prosecution of Section 138 complaints
Defence strategy for accused drawers
Settlement negotiation and compounding
Parallel civil recovery where appropriate

consumer-complaints.name: Consumer Complaints
consumer-complaints.summary: Claims against deficient services and defective goods before consumer forums.
consumer-complaints.description: We help consumers claim compensation for defective products, deficient services, unfair trade practices and insurance or builder disputes before District, State and National Consumer Commissions.
bullets: Drafting and filing of consumer complaints
Builder delay and real-estate claims
Insurance claim rejection disputes
Medical negligence and service deficiency claims
Execution of consumer forum orders

property-disputes.name: Property Disputes
property-disputes.summary: Title, partition, possession and tenancy disputes resolved decisively.
property-disputes.description: Property matters are often a family's most valuable asset at stake. We handle title verification, partition suits, possession and eviction proceedings, boundary disputes and documentation — combining litigation with practical settlement where possible.
bullets: Title search and due diligence before purchase
Partition suits among family members and co-owners
Possession, eviction and tenancy proceedings
Injunctions against illegal construction or dispossession
Sale deed, gift deed and will drafting and registration support

labour-employment-disputes.name: Labour & Employment Disputes
labour-employment-disputes.summary: For employees and employers — termination, dues and service matters.
labour-employment-disputes.description: We advise employees on wrongful termination, unpaid dues, gratuity and PF claims, and represent employers in domestic enquiries, labour court proceedings and compliance matters.
bullets: Wrongful termination and reinstatement claims
Recovery of unpaid salary, gratuity and PF dues
Representation before labour courts and tribunals
Domestic enquiry and disciplinary proceeding support
Employment contract and policy drafting

private-limited-company-registration.name: Private Limited Company Registration
private-limited-company-registration.summary: Incorporation handled end-to-end — name approval to certificate.
private-limited-company-registration.description: We incorporate your private limited company from start to finish: name reservation, digital signatures, drafting of charter documents, filing with the Registrar of Companies and post-incorporation registrations, so you can focus on the business itself.
bullets: Name reservation and availability strategy
DSC and DIN for directors
MoA and AoA drafted for your actual business
Incorporation filing and certificate from the RoC
PAN, TAN and post-incorporation compliance calendar

llp-registration.name: LLP Registration
llp-registration.summary: Limited liability partnership set up with a sound partnership deed.
llp-registration.description: A limited liability partnership combines partnership flexibility with limited liability. We handle incorporation, draft an LLP agreement that anticipates disputes before they arise, and complete all registrar filings.
bullets: LLP name reservation and incorporation filing
Custom LLP agreement — capital, profit sharing, exit terms
Designated partner DSC and DIN
PAN, TAN and bank account documentation
Annual filing and compliance support

partnership-firm-registration.name: Partnership Firm Registration
partnership-firm-registration.summary: Registered partnership deeds that prevent tomorrow's disputes.
partnership-firm-registration.description: We draft and register partnership deeds that clearly record capital contribution, profit sharing, duties and exit terms — the clauses that decide disputes years later — and complete registration with the Registrar of Firms.
bullets: Partnership deed drafting with dispute-proof clauses
Registration with the Registrar of Firms
PAN and bank documentation for the firm
Reconstitution on admission or retirement of partners
Dissolution and settlement of accounts

msme-udyam-registration.name: MSME / Udyam Registration
msme-udyam-registration.summary: Unlock MSME benefits — credit, subsidies and payment protection.
msme-udyam-registration.description: Udyam registration gives micro, small and medium enterprises access to priority lending, subsidies, tender preferences and protection against delayed payments. We complete the registration and advise on the benefits you can actually claim.
bullets: Udyam registration with correct classification
Advice on schemes and subsidies applicable to you
Delayed payment claims under the MSMED Act
Updates and amendments to existing registrations
Bank and tender documentation support

fssai-license.name: FSSAI License
fssai-license.summary: Food business licensing — registration, state and central licenses.
fssai-license.description: Every food business in India needs FSSAI registration or a license. We determine the correct category for your operations, prepare the documentation, file the application and handle renewals and modifications.
bullets: Correct category assessment — registration, state or central
Complete documentation and application filing
Response to queries and inspection support
Renewals, modifications and additional locations
Compliance advice on labelling and hygiene requirements

startup-india-registration.name: Startup India Registration
startup-india-registration.summary: DPIIT recognition — tax benefits and easier compliance for startups.
startup-india-registration.description: DPIIT recognition under Startup India opens tax exemptions, self-certification, faster IP processing and access to government schemes. We prepare your application, pitch documentation and post-recognition filings.
bullets: DPIIT recognition application and documentation
Advice on eligible tax exemptions
Angel tax exemption filings
IP fast-track benefits for recognised startups
Ongoing compliance for recognised entities

gst-registration.name: GST Registration
gst-registration.summary: Fast, correct GST registration with the right classification.
gst-registration.description: We assess whether and where you need GST registration, complete the application with correct HSN/SAC classification, respond to departmental queries and obtain your GSTIN — including amendments and additional places of business.
bullets: Registration liability assessment
Application with correct HSN/SAC classification
Reply to registration queries and clarifications
Amendments — address, business lines, additional places
Composition scheme advice for eligible businesses

gst-return-filing.name: GST Return Filing
gst-return-filing.summary: Accurate monthly and annual returns, reconciled and on time.
gst-return-filing.description: Late or mismatched GST returns invite notices and blocked input credit. We prepare and file your periodic returns, reconcile input tax credit with vendor filings and keep your compliance calendar clean.
bullets: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B preparation and filing
Input tax credit reconciliation with GSTR-2B
Annual return and reconciliation statement
Notice replies for mismatches and late filings
Refund applications for exports and inverted duty

income-tax-return-filing.name: Income Tax Return Filing
income-tax-return-filing.summary: Returns for individuals, professionals and businesses — filed right.
income-tax-return-filing.description: We prepare and file income-tax returns for salaried individuals, professionals, firms and companies — choosing the correct regime, claiming eligible deductions and handling the follow-through when the department raises questions.
bullets: Return preparation for all taxpayer categories
Old vs new regime comparison and planning
Capital gains computation for property and shares
Rectifications and revised returns
Refund tracking and follow-up

tax-notice-reply.name: Tax Notice Reply
tax-notice-reply.summary: Considered, timely replies to income-tax and GST notices.
tax-notice-reply.description: A tax notice has deadlines that must not be missed. We analyse the notice, gather the record, draft a considered reply and represent you before the officer — for scrutiny, demand, penalty and GST show-cause notices alike.
bullets: Notice analysis and risk assessment
Document compilation and reply drafting
Representation before tax authorities
Appeals against adverse orders
Stay applications against recovery

trademark-registration.name: Trademark Registration
trademark-registration.summary: Protect your brand name and logo before someone else does.
trademark-registration.description: Your brand is your reputation. We run a proper availability search, file the application in the correct classes, prosecute it through examination and opposition, and keep watch so nobody rides on your name.
bullets: Comprehensive availability search and risk opinion
Application filing in the correct classes
Reply to examination reports and hearings
Opposition proceedings — for and against
Renewal, assignment and licensing support

copyright-registration.name: Copyright Registration
copyright-registration.summary: Register your creative and software works for enforceable proof.
copyright-registration.description: Registration turns your authorship into enforceable proof. We register literary, artistic, musical and software works, respond to objections and act against infringement — including online takedowns.
bullets: Registration of literary, artistic and software works
Objection replies and discrepancy hearings
Assignment and licensing agreements
Infringement notices and takedown actions
Advice on ownership in commissioned work

patent-filing.name: Patent Filing
patent-filing.summary: From invention disclosure to grant — searches, drafting, prosecution.
patent-filing.description: We take inventions from disclosure to grant: prior-art searches, provisional and complete specifications drafted with claims that actually protect, and prosecution through examination — with honest advice on what is worth patenting.
bullets: Patentability and prior-art search with opinion
Provisional and complete specification drafting
Filing and prosecution before the Patent Office
Response to examination reports and hearings
Renewals and inventor/assignment documentation
